author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: Hiring Comic Artists, Writers & More
content:
HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE ↳

We’re looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects.

These positions include: Lineartist, sketch artist, colorist, storyboard artist, animators, music producers, language translators, comic writers/editors, personal assistants, video/reel editors/promoters, content creators & more.

These positions are paid but we’re open to collaboration / internships.

If you meet the requirements listed, then please send a *PROFESSIONAL* email to: whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com with the following information: Name, general location, Position applying for, Resume/Portfolio with previous & current experience & examples, Rate per panel & for 60 panels (+/-), Rates for services/etc. (be open to negotiations if necessary), Turnaround Time for 60 panels/other work, Programs / Software used (Clip Studio Paint, etc), Preferred Payment Method (However, PayPal is what we will use), Other notable experience / specializations.

*NO DEADLINE, ROLLING APPLICATION ACCEPTANCE*

‼️ ABSOLUTELY NO AI USE IN THE PROCESS OR FINAL DELIVERABLES. ‼️

author: mostafa_gawad
title: Hiring Vector Background Artists
content:
🎨 WE’RE HIRING! – VECTOR BACKGROUND ARTISTS

JUMP ANIMATION is looking for talented Vector Background Artists to join our upcoming animated series project!

Requirements:
* Strong skills in creating 2D vector backgrounds.
* Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator or Adobe Animate.
* Ability to match an established cartoon art style.
* Attention to detail and good artistic skills.

Project Duration: 2–3 Months (Freelance).

📩 Send your CV and Portfolio to:
* jobs@jumpanimation.com
* gawad26@gmail.com

💬 You can also message us directly through Facebook!

If you’re passionate about cartoon backgrounds and 2D animation, we’d love to hear from you!

author: saturdaymorningcards
title: SMC Is Hiring Including Artist Positions
content:
SMC IS HIRING!

Saturday Morning Cards is growing fast and quickly becoming one of the most exciting new brands in the hobby! 🚀🌕

As we take SMC to the next level, we’re building our A-team of qualified, passionate, and highly skilled individuals.

📩 Interested? Email operations@saturdaymorningcards.com with a brief introduction, your résumé, a portfolio sample, and the position you’re interested in.

With the exception of artist positions, all applicants must reside in the greater Orange County, Southern California, area.

This post is for recruitment purposes only and does not guarantee employment. All positions are subject to availability, qualifications, and the hiring process. SMC reserves the right to modify or withdraw opportunities at any time. SMC is an equal opportunity employer.
